SUBJECT:
feat(web): add Claude Agent SDK sidecar and message mapper; bound JSONL line reads
BODY:
Groundwork for driving Claude through the Agent SDK instead of the
claude-agent-acp bridge. Nothing selects it yet; Claude still runs over ACP.

- sidecar: crates/ajax-web/sidecar/claude_sdk_sidecar.mjs wraps one
  long-lived streaming-input query() behind the same JSONL command/response
  framing the Pi RPC child uses; abort maps to interrupt() and keeps the
  process alive; tool permission requests are auto-allowed, elicitation is
  declined; the SDK module is injectable so tests use a fake
- claude_sdk_map: pure mapping from SDK messages to adapter events (text and
  thinking deltas, tool calls and results, usage, finish/abort)
- pi_rpc_process: cap a stdout line at 16 MiB on the read; an over-long line
  becomes one error record and is discarded without buffering
- tests: sidecar driven through the process wrapper with a fake SDK, mapper
  replay of trimmed real transcripts, bounded-reader cases
